integrity: Proof and exact scalar certificate are included, with a supplementary checker and no independent mathematical audit. Priority assessments are based on identified publicly accessible literature and mathematical search; historical priority is not certified.
limitations: Does not treat trees with multiple forks, non-Hilbert norms, or higher powers. The claim is a new quantitative optimization in a classical family and not the earlier qualitative nonhyponormality example.
scientific_scope: Norm-one hyponormal shifts on rooted single-fork trees with finite stems and at least two finite or countably many infinite rays; sharp negative spectral part of the self-commutator of the square.
title: A sharp golden-ratio bound for failure of square hyponormality on one-fork trees
